# datasets/emojis Import

- Source: https://github.com/datasets/emojis
- Raw data: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasets/emojis/main/data/emojis.csv
- Retrieved at: 2026-05-11
- Local manifest: `manifest.json`

## Files

- `emojis.csv`: CSV export generated from Unicode emoji data.
- `README.upstream.md`: upstream README snapshot.

## Integration Policy

Use this only as a convenience CSV for comparison or one-off analysis.

Prefer official Unicode raw files and `muan/unicode-emoji-json` for canonical
ingestion because they give us clearer provenance and less transformation
ambiguity.
